# Structured Map Proxy

> A Java library that creates type-safe JDK proxy interfaces backed by `java.util.Map` instances, enabling typed API access over dynamic map-based data structures.

Key facts:
- Java 21, single-artifact Maven project (OSGi bundle)
- Build: Maven 3.9.4 with Maven Wrapper (`./mvnw`), CI-friendly versioning via `${revision}`
- Core dependency: Google Guava (caching, name conversion, immutable collections)
- Test stack: JUnit 5, Hamcrest, Mockito, JaCoCo coverage
- OSGi-ready bundle exporting `hu.blackbelt.structured.map.proxy.*`
- License: Apache License 2.0

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Library overview, usage examples, Mermaid diagrams, and API reference

## Core Components

- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/structured/map/proxy/MapProxy.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/structured/map/proxy/MapProxy.java): Core InvocationHandler — intercepts interface method calls and routes them to the backing map
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/structured/map/proxy/MapBuilderProxy.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/structured/map/proxy/MapBuilderProxy.java): Builder-pattern proxy — wraps a target type with a fluent builder interface
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/structured/map/proxy/MapHolder.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/structured/map/proxy/MapHolder.java): Contract implemented by all proxies — exposes toMap(), adaptTo(), and internal map access
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/structured/map/proxy/MapProxyParams.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/structured/map/proxy/MapProxyParams.java): Configuration container — immutable, nullSafeCollection, enumMappingMethod settings
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/structured/map/proxy/CompositeClassLoader.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/structured/map/proxy/CompositeClassLoader.java): Custom ClassLoader that delegates to multiple parent class loaders

## Annotations & Utilities

- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/structured/map/proxy/annotation/Key.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/structured/map/proxy/annotation/Key.java): Annotation to map a getter to a custom map key name
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/structured/map/proxy/annotation/Embedded.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/structured/map/proxy/annotation/Embedded.java): Annotation to flatten a nested interface's fields into the parent map level
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/structured/map/proxy/util/ReflectionUtil.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/structured/map/proxy/util/ReflectionUtil.java): Finds getter/setter/adder methods via reflection and Guava CaseFormat
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/structured/map/proxy/util/MapBuilderProxyUtil.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/structured/map/proxy/util/MapBuilderProxyUtil.java): Interface hierarchy analysis for builder proxies
